levels.task_goal: Evaluate whether mechanics, scenes and systems are understandable, engaging, emotionally effective, respectful of player time and worth keeping.
requirements: Run end-to-end builds, deterministic replays, playtests, asset dependency validation, platform checks and failure injection.
Attack busywork disguised as depth, confusion mistaken for challenge, novelty decay, metric-gaming fun proxy.
Persist integration counterexamples and exact reproduction recipes.

levels.task_goal: Evaluate whether mechanics, scenes and systems are understandable, engaging, emotionally effective, respectful of player time and worth keeping.
requirements: Improve engagement proxy, friction detection, learning curve, player-value density plus player value, originality, accessibility, performance, security and maintainability jointly.
Reject release-readiness scores that average away any critical family failure.
Keep prior integrated champion unless the candidate is Pareto-safe.

levels.task_goal: Evaluate whether mechanics, scenes and systems are understandable, engaging, emotionally effective, respectful of player time and worth keeping.
requirements: Support project-level semantic diff, dependency migration, rollback and exact checkpoint recovery.
Resume exact project/canon/rival/evaluator/toolchain identities.
Prove failed integration/release attempts never overwrite the last known-good project.

levels.task_goal: Evaluate whether mechanics, scenes and systems are understandable, engaging, emotionally effective, respectful of player time and worth keeping.
requirements: Run Forge-100/1000/10000 with exactly three stages per round and no wall-clock deadline.
Exercise repeated full-project integration, content sweeps and regression hunts under bounded resources.
Detect cumulative drift, stale assets, evaluator adaptation and local-optimum lock-in.

levels.task_goal: Evaluate whether mechanics, scenes and systems are understandable, engaging, emotionally effective, respectful of player time and worth keeping.
requirements: Require independent exact-head release evidence across every mandatory family and hard gate.
Block unknown incorporated rights, unresolved high similarity risk, critical consistency/accessibility/security/performance/state failures.
Promotion yields a reproducible signed evidence bundle; the level remains unsigned until that evidence exists.
